description: Divides an incoming waveform down into four square sub-harmonics and mixes them with the undivided signal

params.text: Sets how much of the input, squared up at its own rate, goes into the mix
Sets how much of that division's square wave goes into the mix
Sets the division for that row, a whole number from 2 to 16
Scales the mixed output; the O/L lamp lights when the mix passes 11.2V, where the output clips

inputs.text: The waveform to divide; a square wave gives the cleanest result, though any shape works

outputs.text: The mix of the input and the four divided squares, each square swinging between -5V and 5V, the whole clipped at 11.2V

notes: the five mix knobs start at zero, so nothing reaches the output until at least one of them is turned up
this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel
